runtime: Node + jsdom with explicitly supplied measurement fixtures; no device or browser performance claim

tests.name: default instrument titles and every source label explicitly identify simulation
frame collection performs no DOM writes and samples at most twice per second
browser mode reports supplied frame timing and JS heap without CPU percentages
missing, rejected or invalid APIs stay unavailable instead of becoming zero values
simulation is deterministic and responds only illustratively to operation events
operation payloads never fabricate live CPU/RAM readings or insert HTML
mode changes synchronize both instruments, preserve DOM controls and drop demo history
hidden pages stop collectors and avoid treating the hidden gap as frame time
controls keep 44px hit height, numbers are at least 24px and labels at least 11px
destroy disconnects observers, callbacks, event listeners and only its own DOM
